recommendation: Keep the source fix; it removes contradictory local guidance from the built Operations page without broadening the issue beyond the approved search-type boundary.
issue_request: FHIR-51046 was Applied/Persuasive for the FHIR-core Operations page. It requested a conformance MAY, removal of a duplicate list-item "and", and replacement of the old simple-parameter restriction with a rule allowing parameters whose data type has a corresponding search type.
initial_application: Commit d542f8a98c from HL7/fhir#3967 updated the main source/operations.html GET list item, but left two adjacent GET-invocation paragraphs using primitive-only criteria.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread discussed URL formatting for operation parameters, and FHIR-I WGM minutes recorded a 7-0-0 Persuasive with Mod vote about what can be mapped as HTTP parameters. Later Operations page commits for FHIR-45251 and FHIR-41220 touched nearby text but did not remove the stale primitive-only GET criteria.
reconciliation: Changed source/operations.html so both remaining GET-invocation statements use parameters being passed with data types that have corresponding search types, matching the applied FHIR-51046 rule.
source_changes: source/operations.html: changed the introductory GET paragraph from primitive datatypes with no extensions to parameters being passed with data types that have corresponding search types.
source/operations.html: changed the Operation Request GET paragraph from all operation parameters being primitive types to only passed parameters having corresponding search types.
